subject: executor: fix the issue that `INSERT IGNORE` doesn't lock the parent table (#56661)
summary: Reviewed executor FK-check changes: `checkRows` becomes a pointer receiver so `INSERT IGNORE` FK precheck persists `toBeLockedKeys`, and `doCheck` no longer early-returns when only locks are needed, ensuring the parent-table keys get locked via the normal foreign-key trigger path. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; upstream/master retains this behavior (later FK-lock refactors are unrelated).
